name: Toyota Motor Manufacturing Mississippi - Blue Springs MS

fieldNotes.site: TMMMS — Toyota's Mississippi assembly plant (Corolla, Corolla Cross). Single large central assembly building (one contiguous footprint) plus a few small ancillary structures, set in heavily forested rural NE Mississippi between Tupelo and Pontotoc.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced, security-controlled automotive assembly plant with a perimeter loop road. Wide multi-lane internal approach roads with roundabouts lead from the public highway into the campus; truck entrances are controlled checkpoints. truckGate true, high confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Manned guard houses are standard at Toyota assembly-plant primary gates; small guard structures present at the entrances. guardShack true; remoteGs false.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two distinct trailer drop yards on the E and SE sides — dense rows of red/white/colored trailers in dedicated lots (z17-z18 imagery), plus dock-apron trailers. Placed in 25-50 band, flagged uncertain. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Clear dock banks with trailers backed in along the E and W faces of the assembly building; ~90 estimate, 50+ band certain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant is surrounded by dense forest and farmland, well outside Blue Springs MS (a very small town) — clearly Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Site is rural and forested but adjacent to a US highway and the Tupelo metro corridor — cellular coverage likely adequate; connectivityIssue left false but flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound parts dock cluster vs. finished-vehicle outbound staging run from different building faces.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Effectively a single large assembly building with minor ancillary structures — not a multi-building campus; multipleFacilities false.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane internal approach roads and large gate aprons leave clear room for express/bypass lanes.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail-served (standard for an assembly plant of this scale; planned with rail access).
fieldNotes.perimeter: Box covers the core developed campus; TMMMS owns extensive additional forested buffer land beyond it.
